fields.description: Issue features extensive coverage of Miami municipal politics ahead of the May 7, 1935 primary election, including published election odds for city commission candidates and editorials criticizing proposed Florida sales-tax legislation associated with Mayor Sewell and Tallahassee activity. Includes an investigation-style piece alleging chain grocery stores understate stock values to reduce city license fees, and commentary on boxing regulation and a proposed state boxing commissioner. Additional items include discussion of a high-profile robbery investigation, criticism of a Miami Biltmore beauty contest, local social and campus columns, and numerous advertisements for local businesses and entertainment venues.
